ai_summary: Ajax Engineering Limited announced the immediate resignation of its Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Key Managerial Personnel, Mr. Ketan Pendse, effective September 7, 2026. The stated reason for his departure is "personal reasons," with both the company and Mr. Pendse explicitly confirming no other material factors. While the explicit clarification helps mitigate concerns, the promptness of the resignation could pose a short-term leadership transition challenge for the company's financial oversight.
